question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word

Resign
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Resign"** means to voluntarily leave a job or other position. (त्याग पत्र देना)

 
 
• **Example: **She decided to **resign **from her position as the company's CEO.
 
 
 
• **"Surrender"** refers to giving up or yielding, especially in the context of a conflict or competition. (समर्पण करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers had to** surrender** after being surrounded by the enemy.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that a synonym for **'Resign'** is **'Surrender'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Achieve** (प्राप्त करना): Successfully reach a desired objective or result by effort, skill, or courage.

 
 
• **Example:** She worked hard to **achieve **her goals.
 
 
 
• **Insist** (जोर देना): Demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal.
 
 
• **Example:** He** insists** on doing everything himself.
 
 
 
• **Stay** (रुकना): Remain in the same place.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to **stay **at the hotel for an extra night.
